postgres.name: bng.audit_log
postgres.description: A full snapshot of a project after every change, recording who made it and when, for audit history.

postgres.name: bng.baseline_habitats
postgres.description: The mapped outline of each baseline area-habitat parcel imported from the uploaded GeoPackage.

postgres.name: bng.baseline_hedgerows
postgres.description: The mapped line of each baseline hedgerow imported from the uploaded GeoPackage.

postgres.name: bng.baseline_red_line
postgres.description: The single red-line boundary outlining the overall extent of a project's development site.

postgres.name: bng.baseline_watercourses
postgres.description: The mapped line of each baseline watercourse imported from the uploaded GeoPackage.

postgres.name: bng.post_intervention_habitats
postgres.description: The mapped outline of each post-intervention (proposed) area-habitat parcel imported from the uploaded GeoPackage.

postgres.name: bng.post_intervention_hedgerows
postgres.description: The mapped line of each post-intervention (proposed) hedgerow imported from the uploaded GeoPackage.

postgres.name: bng.post_intervention_red_line
postgres.description: The single red-line boundary outlining the extent of the post-intervention (proposed) site.

postgres.name: bng.post_intervention_watercourses
postgres.description: The mapped line of each post-intervention (proposed) watercourse imported from the uploaded GeoPackage.

postgres.name: bng.projects
postgres.description: One row per BNG project, holding the live project document plus its owner and version details.

postgres.name: bng.relationships
postgres.description: The organisations a user is related to, taken from their Defra ID token and upserted on each login (one row per user's relationship).

postgres.name: bng.roles
postgres.description: The roles and their approval status a user holds per organisation relationship, upserted from the Defra ID token on each login; drives project access control.

postgres.name: bng.users
postgres.description: One row per authenticated Defra ID user, upserted from the verified token on each login (identity and last sign-in).
